questions.problem:
The system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}-3x+y+7z=5 \\ x-4y+8z=1 \\ -6y+9z=2\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & 7 \\ 1 & -4 & b \\ 0 & a & 9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}c \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b,$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}-3x+y+7z=5 \\ x-4y+8z=1 \\ 0x-6y+9z=2\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & 7 \\ 1 & -4 & 8 \\ 0 & -6 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & 7 \\ 1 & -4 & 8 \\ 0 & -6 & 9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-6,\,b=8,\,c=5.$

questions.problem:
The system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x-4y+z=2 \\ x-6y+11z=3 \\ 3x-4y-z=4\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & a \\ 1 & b & c \\ 3 & -4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
We can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & 1 \\ 1 & -6 & 11 \\ 3 & -4 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & 1 \\ 1 & -6 & 11 \\ 3 & -4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=1,\,b=-6,\,c=11.$

questions.problem:

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x-5y+z=1 \\ -x-3y+9z=-2 \\ 4x-7y-z=5\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 & c \\ -1 & b & 9 \\ a & -7 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
We can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 & 1 \\ -1 & -3 & 9 \\ 4 & -7 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 & 1 \\ 1 & -3 & 9 \\ 4 & -7 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=4,\,b=-3,\,c=1.$

questions.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2x+y+z=-1 \\ z+3x-2y=3 \\ -y+2z-x=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & b & 1 \\ -1 & -1 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a \\ 3 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
questions.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2x+y+z=-1 \\ 3x-2y+z=3 \\ -x-y+2z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -4\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-1,\,b=-2,\,c=2.$
